latin: Licet ut tradit theologia distinctae sint diuinae hierarchiae, intelligendum est tamen omnia in omnibus esse modo suo.
latin_note: Packet line ends in the hyphenated 'intelligen-'; completed from the next line of the corpus (farmer1998:16167, 'dum est tamen omnia in omnibus esse modo suo'). Confirmed against Black and Wirszubski's quotations, which read 'intelligendum est tamen omnia in omnibus esse modo suo' (black2006:8798; wirszubski1989:12669).
translation: Although the divine hierarchies are distinct, as theology teaches, it must nevertheless be understood that all things are in all things, each in its own manner.
translation_note: Latin restored from the line-break hyphenation 'intelligen-' / 'dum' (farmer1998:16166-16167). 'Theologia' rendered 'theology' as in Pico's own gloss on the Proclean source (see farmer1998:16201, which names the Theologia Platonica). Sense checked against farmer1998:16226.
